commands.Man: Open a man page: :Man {name}, :Man {sect} {name}; no arg = word under cursor
commands.Explore: netrw: browse the current file's directory (or [dir]) in this window
commands.Hexplore: netrw: browse the directory in a horizontal split (! = above)
commands.Lexplore: netrw: toggle a full-height explorer on the left
commands.Sexplore: netrw: split, then browse the current file's directory (! = vertical)
commands.Vexplore: netrw: browse the directory in a vertical split
commands.Texplore: netrw: browse the directory in a new tab
commands.Ntree: netrw: make [dirname] (or the line under the cursor) the tree top
commands.Nread: netrw: re-read the last remote file into this buffer
commands.Nwrite: netrw: write [range] to the last remote file
commands.NetUserPass: netrw: set the user id and password for remote (ftp) access
commands.NoMatchParen: Turn off highlighting of the matching paren under the cursor
commands.MatchDisable: matchit: drop its % g% [% ]% maps (plain bracket %)
commands.MatchDebug: matchit: debug b:match_words (adds a Matchit menu)
commands.Tutor: Open the interactive Vim tutorial (:Tutor {name} for others)
commands.UpdateRemotePlugins: Register remote (rplugin/) plugins; run after installing or updating one
